opening.comment: The agent's first turn did not give their own name or the company name, so the opening is incomplete.

verification.quote:
Customer: Hi, uh is this Tidewell? My toaster doesn't work. It arrived yesterday. My name is Niamh Willems, postcode 3513 AA.
Agent: Yes. Thank you, Niamh, that matches your account.
verification.comment: The caller gave full name and postcode and the agent confirmed them against the account before proceeding.

understanding.quote: Agent: So the toaster arrived yesterday and doesn't turn on at all?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue accurately and did not re-ask for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.comment: Items under EUR 25 need no return, so 'No' is correct only if the toaster is under EUR 25; the refund is also within 5 working days, but the agent gave the amount as EUR 22.0 without confirming that the item was damaged or faulty on arrival and that a photo was requested.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: I'll refund the full €22.0 to your card, you'll see it within 5 working days.
process_compliance.comment: The agent promised a refund for a faulty item without asking for a photo first, which the policy requires before arranging a replacement or refund.

communication.quote: Agent: I'm sorry it uh doesn't work out of the box, that's disappointing.
communication.comment: The agent was polite and acknowledged the caller's problem with an apology, though the closing remark 'Right then.' was curt.

closing.comment: The agent did not confirm next steps fully or ask whether the caller needed anything else before ending the call.
